Article 1

In this Qanun, what is meant by:

1. Region is Bireuen Regency.
2. Regency is Bireuen Regency which is part of the Aceh provincial region led by a Regent.
3. Regency Government is the Government of Bireuen Regency as the administration of affairs carried out by the regency government and the Bireuen Regency House of Representatives in accordance with their respective functions and authorities.
4. Regency Administration is an element of the Regency Government administration consisting of the Regent and regency apparatus.
5. Regent is the Head of Bireuen Regency Government elected through a democratic process conducted on the principles of direct, general, free, secret, honest and fair in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Regency House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRK, is an element of Bireuen Regency government administration whose members are elected through general elections in accordance with laws and regulations.
7. Woman is a person (human being) who has reached 15 years of age who menstruates, becomes pregnant, gives birth and breastfeeds.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving just and equal relations with men.
9. Victim is a woman who experiences threats of violence and/or violence inside and/or outside the household and/or becomes an object of trafficking/exploitation, and/or discrimination in all its forms and aspects.

10.Threat of Violence is any act of non-physical abuse with or without using means unlawfully that may cause danger to the body, life, freedom and human rights of women.

11. Violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of freedom unlawfully, both within and outside the household.

12. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, irrespective of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.

13. Women's Rights are all rights possessed by every woman which are part of human rights.

14. Special Protection is protection provided to women and children in emergency situations, women and children in conflict with the law, women and children from minority and isolated groups, women and children who are economically and/or sexually exploited, women and children who are trafficked, women and children who are victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, women and children victims of physical and/or mental violence.

15. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.

16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.

17.Workforce is every person who is able to perform work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.

18. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or compensation in other forms.

19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience barriers and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurrence of violence against victims.

2 1. Rehabilitation is a series of actions carried out by the authorized party in their field to restore the physical, mental and psychosocial condition of women to their original condition.

Article 18

(1) The implementation of protection for women victims of violence as referred to in Article 9 letter h, in the framework of providing legal protection and/or health recovery.

(2) Protection for women victims of violence as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:

a. legal aid;
b. assistance following acts of violence;
c. social rehabilitation and reintegration; and
d. health services.

Article 19

(1) Every victim as referred to in Article 18 has the right to receive protection, information, integrated services, continuous handling up to the rehabilitation stage and confidential handling from individuals, groups or institutions both the Regency Government and the community.

(2) In the event of violence, every victim has the right to receive health services and assistance, both psychologically and legally as well as to receive guarantees of their rights related to their status as women.

Article 22

(1) The Regency Government has obligations and responsibilities towards the protection of women.

(2) Efforts to protect women as referred to in paragraph (1) include:

a. formulation of policies, programs, and activities; b.formulation of implementation guidelines;
c. provision of services; and
d. coordination of policies, programs and activities.
(3) Protection of women as referred to in paragraph (2) is carried out in an integrated manner in accordance with the laws and regulations.

Article 42

This Qanun comes into force on the date of its promulgation.

So that everyone may know, the promulgation of this Qanun is ordered by placing it in the Gazette of Bireuen Regency.

ELUCIDATION

ON

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

3. The obligation of the Bireuen Regency Government feels the need to have a Qanun of Bireuen Regency on the Empowerment and Protection of Women is expected that every woman can be empowered and receive protection without discrimination and the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) that already exists in Bireuen Regency has a Juridical Basis as one of the organizers of empowerment and protection of women in Bireuen Regency.

Article 12

(1) Women heads of household as referred to in Article 9 letter b, are widows whose husbands have died and as a result of divorce must receive protection.

(2) Implementation of protection for women heads of household as referred to in paragraph (1) in order to provide protection and prevention against forms of discrimination, negative stigma and economic empowerment for women heads of household.

(3) Women as heads of household as referred to in paragraph (2) receive the right to protection against:

a. acts of discrimination and efforts to weaken the function of women as the economic support of the family;
b. strengthening capacity and recognition as head of household in her environment; and
c. accessibility to economic and financial institutions.
(4) Implementation of protection for women as heads of household whose husbands have died as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: a. women as heads of household receive 1/8 (one-eighth) of the total remaining property of her husband if she has children; and b. women as heads of household receive 1/4 (one-quarter) of the total remaining property of her husband if she does not have children.
(5) Implementation of protection for women as heads of household due to divorce as referred to in paragraph (1) during the iddah period, the former husband is responsible for providing shelter and support.

Article 15

(2) Women with disabilities as referred to in paragraph (1) receive the right to protection over: a.guarantee of continuity and personal self-development; b.accessibility of information, legal aid, mobility, social services; and c. early intervention efforts including treatment and rehabilitation to improve their function and capacity.

Article 1

In this Qanun, what is meant by:

1. Region is Bireuen Regency.
2. Regency is Bireuen Regency which is part of the Aceh provincial region led by a Regent.
3. Regency Government is the Government of Bireuen Regency as the administration of affairs carried out by the regency government and the Bireuen Regency House of Representatives in accordance with their respective functions and authorities.
4. Regency Administration is an element of the Regency Government administration consisting of the Regent and regency apparatus.
5. Regent is the Head of Bireuen Regency Government elected through a democratic process conducted on the principles of direct, general, free, secret, honest and fair in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Regency House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRK, is an element of Bireuen Regency government administration whose members are elected through general elections in accordance with laws and regulations.
7. Woman is a person (human being) who has reached 15 years of age who menstruates, becomes pregnant, gives birth and breastfeeds.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving just and equal relations with men.
9. Victim is a woman who experiences threats of violence and/or violence inside and/or outside the household and/or becomes an object of trafficking/exploitation, and/or discrimination in all its forms and aspects.

10.Threat of Violence is any act of non-physical abuse with or without using means unlawfully that may cause danger to the body, life, freedom and human rights of women.

11. Violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of freedom unlawfully, both within and outside the household.

12. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, irrespective of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.

13. Women's Rights are all rights possessed by every woman which are part of human rights.

14. Special Protection is protection provided to women and children in emergency situations, women and children in conflict with the law, women and children from minority and isolated groups, women and children who are economically and/or sexually exploited, women and children who are trafficked, women and children who are victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, women and children victims of physical and/or mental violence.

15. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.

16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.

17.Workforce is every person who is able to perform work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.

18. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or compensation in other forms.

19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience barriers and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurrence of violence against victims.

2 1. Rehabilitation is a series of actions carried out by the authorized party in their field to restore the physical, mental and psychosocial condition of women to their original condition.

ELUCIDATION

ON

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

3. The obligation of the Bireuen Regency Government feels the need to have a Qanun of Bireuen Regency on the Empowerment and Protection of Women is expected that every woman can be empowered and receive protection without discrimination and the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) that already exists in Bireuen Regency has a Juridical Basis as one of the organizers of empowerment and protection of women in Bireuen Regency.

a. acts of discrimination and efforts to weaken the function of women as the economic support of the family;

c. accessibility to economic and financial institutions.

ELUCIDATION

ON

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

3. The obligation of the Bireuen Regency Government feels the need to have a Qanun of Bireuen Regency on the Empowerment and Protection of Women is expected that every woman can be empowered and receive protection without discrimination and the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) that already exists in Bireuen Regency has a Juridical Basis as one of the organizers of empowerment and protection of women in Bireuen Regency.

Article 14

(1) Implementation of protection for women workers/laborers as referred to in Article 9 letter d, to provide protection from acts of economic exploitation and cruel, inhumane treatment and to pursue decent recognition for work.

(2) Women workers/laborers as referred to in paragraph (1) must receive protection from employers in the form of:

a. recognition of rights, wages and decent working conditions; b. health and social security; and
c. guarantee not to commit discrimination, inhumane treatment, degrading human dignity, and exploitation.

Article 13

a. recognition of rights, wages and decent working conditions; b. health and social security; and c. guarantee not to commit discrimination, inhumane treatment, degrading human dignity, and exploitation.

3. Regency Government is the Government of Bireuen Regency as the administration of affairs carried out by the regency government and the Bireuen Regency House of Representatives in accordance with their respective functions and authorities.
4. Regency Administration is an element of the Regency Government administration consisting of the Regent and regency apparatus.
5. Regent is the Head of Bireuen Regency Government elected through a democratic process conducted on the principles of direct, general, free, secret, honest and fair in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Regency House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRK, is an element of Bireuen Regency government administration whose members are elected through general elections in accordance with laws and regulations.
7. Woman is a person (human being) who has reached 15 years of age who menstruates, becomes pregnant, gives birth and breastfeeds.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving just and equal relations with men.
9. Victim is a woman who experiences threats of violence and/or violence inside and/or outside the household and/or becomes an object of trafficking/exploitation, and/or discrimination in all its forms and aspects.

10.Threat of Violence is any act of non-physical abuse with or without using means unlawfully that may cause danger to the body, life, freedom and human rights of women.

11. Violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of freedom unlawfully, both within and outside the household.

12. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, irrespective of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.

13. Women's Rights are all rights possessed by every woman which are part of human rights.

14. Special Protection is protection provided to women and children in emergency situations, women and children in conflict with the law, women and children from minority and isolated groups, women and children who are economically and/or sexually exploited, women and children who are trafficked, women and children who are victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, women and children victims of physical and/or mental violence.

15. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.

16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.

17.Workforce is every person who is able to perform work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.

18. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or compensation in other forms.

19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience barriers and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurrence of violence against victims.

2 1. Rehabilitation is a series of actions carried out by the authorized party in their field to restore the physical, mental and psychosocial condition of women to their original condition.

Article 18

(1) The implementation of protection for women victims of violence as referred to in Article 9 letter h, in the framework of providing legal protection and/or health recovery.

(2) Protection for women victims of violence as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:

a. legal aid;
b. assistance following acts of violence;
c. social rehabilitation and reintegration; and
d. health services.

Article 19

(1) Every victim as referred to in Article 18 has the right to receive protection, information, integrated services, continuous handling up to the rehabilitation stage and confidential handling from individuals, groups or institutions both the Regency Government and the community.

(2) In the event of violence, every victim has the right to receive health services and assistance, both psychologically and legally as well as to receive guarantees of their rights related to their status as women.

3. I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

Article 1

In this Qanun, what is meant by:

1. Region is Bireuen Regency.
2. Regency is Bireuen Regency which is part of the Aceh provincial region led by a Regent.
3. Regency Government is the Government of Bireuen Regency as the administration of affairs carried out by the regency government and the Bireuen Regency House of Representatives in accordance with their respective functions and authorities.
4. Regency Administration is an element of the Regency Government administration consisting of the Regent and regency apparatus.
5. Regent is the Head of Bireuen Regency Government elected through a democratic process conducted on the principles of direct, general, free, secret, honest and fair in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Regency House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRK, is an element of Bireuen Regency government administration whose members are elected through general elections in accordance with laws and regulations.
7. Woman is a person (human being) who has reached 15 years of age who menstruates, becomes pregnant, gives birth and breastfeeds.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving just and equal relations with men.
9. Victim is a woman who experiences threats of violence and/or violence inside and/or outside the household and/or becomes an object of trafficking/exploitation, and/or discrimination in all its forms and aspects.

10.Threat of Violence is any act of non-physical abuse with or without using means unlawfully that may cause danger to the body, life, freedom and human rights of women.

11. Violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of freedom unlawfully, both within and outside the household.

12. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, irrespective of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.

13. Women's Rights are all rights possessed by every woman which are part of human rights.

14. Special Protection is protection provided to women and children in emergency situations, women and children in conflict with the law, women and children from minority and isolated groups, women and children who are economically and/or sexually exploited, women and children who are trafficked, women and children who are victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, women and children victims of physical and/or mental violence.

15. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.

16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.

17.Workforce is every person who is able to perform work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.

18. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or compensation in other forms.

19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience barriers and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurrence of violence against victims.

2 1. Rehabilitation is a series of actions carried out by the authorized party in their field to restore the physical, mental and psychosocial condition of women to their original condition.

Article 1

In this Qanun, what is meant by:

1. Region is Bireuen Regency.

6. Regency House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRK, is an element of Bireuen Regency government administration whose members are elected through general elections in accordance with laws and regulations.
7. Woman is a person (human being) who has reached 15 years of age who menstruates, becomes pregnant, gives birth and breastfeeds.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving just and equal relations with men.
9. Victim is a woman who experiences threats of violence and/or violence inside and/or outside the household and/or becomes an object of trafficking/exploitation, and/or discrimination in all its forms and aspects.

10.Threat of Violence is any act of non-physical abuse with or without using means unlawfully that may cause danger to the body, life, freedom and human rights of women.

11. Violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of freedom unlawfully, both within and outside the household.

12. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, irrespective of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.

13. Women's Rights are all rights possessed by every woman which are part of human rights.

14. Special Protection is protection provided to women and children in emergency situations, women and children in conflict with the law, women and children from minority and isolated groups, women and children who are economically and/or sexually exploited, women and children who are trafficked, women and children who are victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, women and children victims of physical and/or mental violence.

15. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.

16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.

17.Workforce is every person who is able to perform work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.

18. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or compensation in other forms.

19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience barriers and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurrence of violence against victims.

6. Regency House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRK, is an element of Bireuen Regency government administration whose members are elected through general elections in accordance with laws and regulations.
7. Woman is a person (human being) who has reached 15 years of age who menstruates, becomes pregnant, gives birth and breastfeeds.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving just and equal relations with men.
9. Victim is a woman who experiences threats of violence and/or violence inside and/or outside the household and/or becomes an object of trafficking/exploitation, and/or discrimination in all its forms and aspects.

10.Threat of Violence is any act of non-physical abuse with or without using means unlawfully that may cause danger to the body, life, freedom and human rights of women.

12. 14. 15. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.

16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.

17.Workforce is every person who is able to perform work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.

18. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or compensation in other forms.

19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience barriers and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurrence of violence against victims.

2 1. Rehabilitation is a series of actions carried out by the authorized party in their field to restore the physical, mental and psychosocial condition of women to their original condition.

(1) The Regency Government has obligations and responsibilities towards the protection of women.

ELUCIDATION

ON

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

3. The obligation of the Bireuen Regency Government feels the need to have a Qanun of Bireuen Regency on the Empowerment and Protection of Women is expected that every woman can be empowered and receive protection without discrimination and the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) that already exists in Bireuen Regency has a Juridical Basis as one of the organizers of empowerment and protection of women in Bireuen Regency.

Article 1

In this Qanun, what is meant by:

1. Region is Bireuen Regency.
2. Regency is Bireuen Regency which is part of the Aceh provincial region led by a Regent.
3. Regency Government is the Government of Bireuen Regency as the administration of affairs carried out by the regency government and the Bireuen Regency House of Representatives in accordance with their respective functions and authorities.
4. Regency Administration is an element of the Regency Government administration consisting of the Regent and regency apparatus.
5. Regent is the Head of Bireuen Regency Government elected through a democratic process conducted on the principles of direct, general, free, secret, honest and fair in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Regency House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRK, is an element of Bireuen Regency government administration whose members are elected through general elections in accordance with laws and regulations.
7. Woman is a person (human being) who has reached 15 years of age who menstruates, becomes pregnant, gives birth and breastfeeds.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving just and equal relations with men.
9. Victim is a woman who experiences threats of violence and/or violence inside and/or outside the household and/or becomes an object of trafficking/exploitation, and/or discrimination in all its forms and aspects.

10.Threat of Violence is any act of non-physical abuse with or without using means unlawfully that may cause danger to the body, life, freedom and human rights of women.

11. Violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of freedom unlawfully, both within and outside the household.

12. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, irrespective of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.

13. Women's Rights are all rights possessed by every woman which are part of human rights.

14. Special Protection is protection provided to women and children in emergency situations, women and children in conflict with the law, women and children from minority and isolated groups, women and children who are economically and/or sexually exploited, women and children who are trafficked, women and children who are victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, women and children victims of physical and/or mental violence.

15. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.

16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.

17.Workforce is every person who is able to perform work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.

18. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or compensation in other forms.

19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience barriers and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurrence of violence against victims.

2 1. Rehabilitation is a series of actions carried out by the authorized party in their field to restore the physical, mental and psychosocial condition of women to their original condition.

2. ELUCIDATION

ON

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

3. The obligation of the Bireuen Regency Government feels the need to have a Qanun of Bireuen Regency on the Empowerment and Protection of Women is expected that every woman can be empowered and receive protection without discrimination and the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) that already exists in Bireuen Regency has a Juridical Basis as one of the organizers of empowerment and protection of women in Bireuen Regency.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 1

In this Qanun, what is meant by:

1. Region is Bireuen Regency.
2. Regency is Bireuen Regency which is part of the Aceh provincial region led by a Regent.
3. Regency Government is the Government of Bireuen Regency as the administration of affairs carried out by the regency government and the Bireuen Regency House of Representatives in accordance with their respective functions and authorities.
4. Regency Administration is an element of the Regency Government administration consisting of the Regent and regency apparatus.
5. Regent is the Head of Bireuen Regency Government elected through a democratic process conducted on the principles of direct, general, free, secret, honest and fair in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Regency House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRK, is an element of Bireuen Regency government administration whose members are elected through general elections in accordance with laws and regulations.
7. Woman is a person (human being) who has reached 15 years of age who menstruates, becomes pregnant, gives birth and breastfeeds.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving just and equal relations with men.
9. Victim is a woman who experiences threats of violence and/or violence inside and/or outside the household and/or becomes an object of trafficking/exploitation, and/or discrimination in all its forms and aspects.

10.Threat of Violence is any act of non-physical abuse with or without using means unlawfully that may cause danger to the body, life, freedom and human rights of women.

11. Violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of freedom unlawfully, both within and outside the household.

12. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, irrespective of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.

13. Women's Rights are all rights possessed by every woman which are part of human rights.

14. Special Protection is protection provided to women and children in emergency situations, women and children in conflict with the law, women and children from minority and isolated groups, women and children who are economically and/or sexually exploited, women and children who are trafficked, women and children who are victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, women and children victims of physical and/or mental violence.

15. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.

16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.

17.Workforce is every person who is able to perform work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.

18. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or compensation in other forms.

19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience barriers and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurrence of violence against victims.

2 1. Rehabilitation is a series of actions carried out by the authorized party in their field to restore the physical, mental and psychosocial condition of women to their original condition.

ELUCIDATION

ON

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

3. The obligation of the Bireuen Regency Government feels the need to have a Qanun of Bireuen Regency on the Empowerment and Protection of Women is expected that every woman can be empowered and receive protection without discrimination and the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) that already exists in Bireuen Regency has a Juridical Basis as one of the organizers of empowerment and protection of women in Bireuen Regency.

Article 1

In this Qanun, what is meant by:

1. Region is Bireuen Regency.
2. Regency is Bireuen Regency which is part of the Aceh provincial region led by a Regent.
3. Regency Government is the Government of Bireuen Regency as the administration of affairs carried out by the regency government and the Bireuen Regency House of Representatives in accordance with their respective functions and authorities.
4. Regency Administration is an element of the Regency Government administration consisting of the Regent and regency apparatus.
5. Regent is the Head of Bireuen Regency Government elected through a democratic process conducted on the principles of direct, general, free, secret, honest and fair in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Regency House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRK, is an element of Bireuen Regency government administration whose members are elected through general elections in accordance with laws and regulations.
7. Woman is a person (human being) who has reached 15 years of age who menstruates, becomes pregnant, gives birth and breastfeeds.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving just and equal relations with men.
9. Victim is a woman who experiences threats of violence and/or violence inside and/or outside the household and/or becomes an object of trafficking/exploitation, and/or discrimination in all its forms and aspects.

10.Threat of Violence is any act of non-physical abuse with or without using means unlawfully that may cause danger to the body, life, freedom and human rights of women.

11. Violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of freedom unlawfully, both within and outside the household.

12. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, irrespective of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.

13. Women's Rights are all rights possessed by every woman which are part of human rights.

14. Special Protection is protection provided to women and children in emergency situations, women and children in conflict with the law, women and children from minority and isolated groups, women and children who are economically and/or sexually exploited, women and children who are trafficked, women and children who are victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, women and children victims of physical and/or mental violence.

15. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.

16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.

17.Workforce is every person who is able to perform work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.

18. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or compensation in other forms.

19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience barriers and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurrence of violence against victims.

2 1. Rehabilitation is a series of actions carried out by the authorized party in their field to restore the physical, mental and psychosocial condition of women to their original condition.

ELUCIDATION

ON

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

3. The obligation of the Bireuen Regency Government feels the need to have a Qanun of Bireuen Regency on the Empowerment and Protection of Women is expected that every woman can be empowered and receive protection without discrimination and the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) that already exists in Bireuen Regency has a Juridical Basis as one of the organizers of empowerment and protection of women in Bireuen Regency.

I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

3. The obligation of the Bireuen Regency Government feels the need to have a Qanun of Bireuen Regency on the Empowerment and Protection of Women is expected that every woman can be empowered and receive protection without discrimination and the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) that already exists in Bireuen Regency has a Juridical Basis as one of the organizers of empowerment and protection of women in Bireuen Regency.

ELUCIDATION

ON

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

3. The obligation of the Bireuen Regency Government feels the need to have a Qanun of Bireuen Regency on the Empowerment and Protection of Women is expected that every woman can be empowered and receive protection without discrimination and the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) that already exists in Bireuen Regency has a Juridical Basis as one of the organizers of empowerment and protection of women in Bireuen Regency.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 18

(1) The implementation of protection for women victims of violence as referred to in Article 9 letter h, in the framework of providing legal protection and/or health recovery.

(2) Protection for women victims of violence as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:

a. legal aid;
b. assistance following acts of violence;
c. social rehabilitation and reintegration; and
d. health services.

Article 15

(1) The implementation of protection for women with disabilities as referred to in Article 9 letter e, in the framework of providing protection and prevention, against forms of discrimination including freedom from cruel, inhuman, degrading treatment, and freedom from exploitation.

(2) Women with disabilities as referred to in paragraph (1) receive the right to protection over: a.guarantee of continuity and personal self-development; b.accessibility of information, legal aid, mobility, social services; and c. early intervention efforts including treatment and rehabilitation to improve their function and capacity.

Article 10

Implementation of protection for women as housewives as referred to in Article 9 letter a, in the following matters: a. material and spiritual support;

b. the head of the family provides special protection to the housewife during pregnancy; and

c. a housewife who has given birth must receive protection from the head of the family to reduce the burden as a housewife.

Article 12

(1) Women heads of household as referred to in Article 9 letter b, are widows whose husbands have died and as a result of divorce must receive protection.

(2) Implementation of protection for women heads of household as referred to in paragraph (1) in order to provide protection and prevention against forms of discrimination, negative stigma and economic empowerment for women heads of household.

(3) Women as heads of household as referred to in paragraph (2) receive the right to protection against:

a. acts of discrimination and efforts to weaken the function of women as the economic support of the family;
b. strengthening capacity and recognition as head of household in her environment; and
c. accessibility to economic and financial institutions.
(4) Implementation of protection for women as heads of household whose husbands have died as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: a. women as heads of household receive 1/8 (one-eighth) of the total remaining property of her husband if she has children; and b. women as heads of household receive 1/4 (one-quarter) of the total remaining property of her husband if she does not have children.
(5) Implementation of protection for women as heads of household due to divorce as referred to in paragraph (1) during the iddah period, the former husband is responsible for providing shelter and support.

Article 1

In this Qanun, what is meant by:

1. Region is Bireuen Regency.
2. Regency is Bireuen Regency which is part of the Aceh provincial region led by a Regent.
3. Regency Government is the Government of Bireuen Regency as the administration of affairs carried out by the regency government and the Bireuen Regency House of Representatives in accordance with their respective functions and authorities.
4. Regency Administration is an element of the Regency Government administration consisting of the Regent and regency apparatus.
5. Regent is the Head of Bireuen Regency Government elected through a democratic process conducted on the principles of direct, general, free, secret, honest and fair in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Regency House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRK, is an element of Bireuen Regency government administration whose members are elected through general elections in accordance with laws and regulations.
7. Woman is a person (human being) who has reached 15 years of age who menstruates, becomes pregnant, gives birth and breastfeeds.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving just and equal relations with men.
9. Victim is a woman who experiences threats of violence and/or violence inside and/or outside the household and/or becomes an object of trafficking/exploitation, and/or discrimination in all its forms and aspects.

10.Threat of Violence is any act of non-physical abuse with or without using means unlawfully that may cause danger to the body, life, freedom and human rights of women.

11. Violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of freedom unlawfully, both within and outside the household.

12. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, irrespective of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.

13. Women's Rights are all rights possessed by every woman which are part of human rights.

14. Special Protection is protection provided to women and children in emergency situations, women and children in conflict with the law, women and children from minority and isolated groups, women and children who are economically and/or sexually exploited, women and children who are trafficked, women and children who are victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, women and children victims of physical and/or mental violence.

15. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.

16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.

17.Workforce is every person who is able to perform work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.

18. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or compensation in other forms.

19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience barriers and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurrence of violence against victims.

2 1. Rehabilitation is a series of actions carried out by the authorized party in their field to restore the physical, mental and psychosocial condition of women to their original condition.

ELUCIDATION

ON

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

3. The obligation of the Bireuen Regency Government feels the need to have a Qanun of Bireuen Regency on the Empowerment and Protection of Women is expected that every woman can be empowered and receive protection without discrimination and the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) that already exists in Bireuen Regency has a Juridical Basis as one of the organizers of empowerment and protection of women in Bireuen Regency.

ELUCIDATION

ON

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

1. That Islamic Shari'a grants a high and noble position to women. Women have the same position as men as servants of Allah and dignified beings. In the Qur'an and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad SAW, no teachings or activities are ever found that lead to discrimination and exploitation of women. In fact, one of the missions of the Prophet Muhammad SAW in this world is to elevate the dignity and honor of women from a very low and despicable state.

2. That Law Number 44 of 1999 concerning the Implementation of the Special Status of Aceh and Law Number 11 of 2006 concerning the Government of Aceh have provided a foundation for the empowerment and protection of women which is an important activity because the condition of women so far is quite concerning in terms of education, economy, health, labor, law and even the threat of violence, exploitation, discrimination, pornography and pornographic acts that are often targeted at women.

3. The obligation of the Bireuen Regency Government feels the need to have a Qanun of Bireuen Regency on the Empowerment and Protection of Women is expected that every woman can be empowered and receive protection without discrimination and the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A) that already exists in Bireuen Regency has a Juridical Basis as one of the organizers of empowerment and protection of women in Bireuen Regency.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 39

(1) To ensure synergy, continuity, and effectiveness of integrated measures in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women, the Regency Government conducts monitoring.

(2) The monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is intended to determine developments and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women.

(3) Monitoring is conducted periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of regional apparatus that implement policies, programs and activities for the protection of women.

(4) Monitoring is conducted from planning to implementation of policies, programs and activities.

Part Four

Special Treatment

Article 1

In this Qanun, what is meant by:

1. Region is Bireuen Regency.
2. Regency is Bireuen Regency which is part of the Aceh provincial region led by a Regent.
3. Regency Government is the Government of Bireuen Regency as the administration of affairs carried out by the regency government and the Bireuen Regency House of Representatives in accordance with their respective functions and authorities.
4. Regency Administration is an element of the Regency Government administration consisting of the Regent and regency apparatus.
5. Regent is the Head of Bireuen Regency Government elected through a democratic process conducted on the principles of direct, general, free, secret, honest and fair in accordance with laws and regulations.
6. Regency House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRK, is an element of Bireuen Regency government administration whose members are elected through general elections in accordance with laws and regulations.
7. Woman is a person (human being) who has reached 15 years of age who menstruates, becomes pregnant, gives birth and breastfeeds.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving just and equal relations with men.
9. Victim is a woman who experiences threats of violence and/or violence inside and/or outside the household and/or becomes an object of trafficking/exploitation, and/or discrimination in all its forms and aspects.

10.Threat of Violence is any act of non-physical abuse with or without using means unlawfully that may cause danger to the body, life, freedom and human rights of women.

11. Violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of freedom unlawfully, both within and outside the household.

12. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, irrespective of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.

13. Women's Rights are all rights possessed by every woman which are part of human rights.

14. Special Protection is protection provided to women and children in emergency situations, women and children in conflict with the law, women and children from minority and isolated groups, women and children who are economically and/or sexually exploited, women and children who are trafficked, women and children who are victims of kidnapping, sale, trafficking, women and children victims of physical and/or mental violence.

15. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.

16. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.

17.Workforce is every person who is able to perform work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.

18. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or compensation in other forms.

19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations for a long period of time who in interacting with the environment may experience barriers and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.

20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurrence of violence against victims.

2 1. Rehabilitation is a series of actions carried out by the authorized party in their field to restore the physical, mental and psychosocial condition of women to their original condition.
